description: US public market investor / insider / Congressional monitoring starter roster, not a performance ranking or verified trading track record
data_quality_rules: Match to SEC CIK, legal filing entity and Congress BioGuide ID before production; never join by name only.
For SEC Form 4, distinguish open-market P/S from M/F/G and 10b5-1 planned trades.
Retain transaction_date, accepted_at, reported_at and observed_at separately; compute public information latency.
ARK trades are fund trades reported after market close; not Cathie Wood personal trades.
13F filings are snapshots of covered long positions at quarter-end; options reported without strike or expiry, and shorts are generally absent.
Congressional PTR figures are usually amount ranges, and can include spouses/dependents.
Review Senate eFD commercial-use limitations before commercializing the data.
Recheck reporting-person roles, employment, filing status and public-source licensing regularly.
No entry represents a claim of superior investment returns or a recommendation to copy a trade.
